info.title: Mars-Data weather API
info.summary: Latest Curiosity (MSL/REMS) surface weather sol, served by `marsdata serve`.
info.description: `marsdata serve` fetches the latest sol from NASA's public Mars Science Laboratory weather feed on startup and then every `server.refresh_interval_secs` (default 3600). It serves the most recent successful fetch. A failed refresh is logged and the previous sample keeps being served. The API is unauthenticated and binds `server.host`:`server.port` (default `127.0.0.1:3000`).

get.description: Returns 200 once the process is serving, whether or not weather data has been fetched yet.

200.description: The server is up. Empty body.

get.description: The most recently fetched sol. Returns 503 until the first fetch after startup succeeds; after that it always returns the latest successful sample.

503.description: No sample has been fetched yet.

Temperature.description: Degrees Celsius, or null when the feed has no reading.

WindDirection.description: Compass point. `Unknown` when the feed has the field but an unrecognised value (including its `--` sentinel); null when the field is absent.

AtmoOpacity.description: Sky condition. `Unknown` for an unrecognised value; null when the field is absent.

UvIndex.description: Local UV irradiance index. `Unknown` for an unrecognised value; null when the field is absent.

PressureDirection.description: Pressure trend: `Rising` when the feed reports `Higher`, otherwise `Falling`; null when the field is absent.

WeatherSample.description: One sol of REMS weather. Every key is always present; a reading the feed lacks or marks with its `--` sentinel is null.

sol.description: Mission sol number. 0 when the feed's value is missing or not a whole number.

pressure.description: Atmospheric pressure as reported by the feed.

mars_season.description: Solar longitude (the feed's `ls` field) in whole degrees.

abs_humidity.description: Absolute humidity as reported by the feed.

wind_speed.description: Wind speed as reported by the feed.

season.description: Feed season label (e.g. `Month 12`), truncated on a character boundary to at most 32 UTF-8 bytes.
